title: Efficient Context Selection for Long-Context QA: No Tuning, No Iteration, Just Adaptive-$k$
authors: Chihiro Taguchi; Seiji Maekawa; Nikita Bhutani
why_relevant: Proposes an adaptive method to dynamically decide how many passages to retrieve based on similarity score distributions, addressing the control problem of when/how much to retrieve and reducing noisy/irrelevant context.
why_not_or_caveat: Focus is on efficiency and accuracy rather than robustness per se; touches calibration-of-retrieval-size only indirectly.
